result.instructions: Tools for WizCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which companies can this token open in WizCloud?"; "Run my monthly VAT report from WizCloud for the last quarter."; "Check journal batch 12 for errors before my accountant issues it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WizCloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wizcloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wizcloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wizcloud_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wizcloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wizcloud_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the WizCloud companies this token can open: file name, company name and VAT number. Call this first to find the database for a company. Source: POST CompanyListToTokenApi/TokenCompanies.

tools.name: wizcloud_export_report
tools.title: Run a saved report
tools.description: Run a report that the customer designed in the WizCloud Report Planner and exported with the External option. Pass that file's datafile string and, if the report has parameters, its parameters array. Returns the report rows as JSON. Source: POST ExportDataApi/exportData.

datafile.description: The datafile string from the report's External export file.

parameters.description: Parameter objects from the same export file, with the defVal values you want.

tools.name: wizcloud_list_trigger_urls
tools.title: List trigger addresses
tools.description: List the web addresses that WizCloud calls when data changes (trigger addresses). Source: POST TriggersApi/getURL.

tools.name: wizcloud_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Show one document (invoice, delivery note, order, quotation) by its StockID. Source: POST invApi/getDoc.

tools.name: wizcloud_check_journal_batch
tools.title: Check a journal batch
tools.description: Check a temporary journal batch for errors before anyone issues it in WizCloud. Read-only. Source: POST jtransApi/chkBatch.

tools.name: wizcloud_create_temp_document
tools.title: Create a temporary document
tools.description: Create or update a TEMPORARY document (invoice, delivery note, order, quotation). It is not in permanent storage until a user issues it in WizCloud. Source: POST invApi/createDoc.

issue_stock.description: Update stock with the document's moves (default false).

delete_temp.description: Delete the temporary copy after the import (default false).

StockID.description: 0 creates a new document; an existing id updates it.

rows.description: The document header and its moves (lines). Other fields follow the WizCloud Import Documents page.

tools.name: wizcloud_create_temp_journal_batch
tools.title: Create a temporary journal batch
tools.description: Add journal transactions to a TEMPORARY batch. They are not in permanent storage until a user issues the batch in WizCloud. Run wizcloud_check_journal_batch after. Source: POST jtransApi/tmpBatch.

batch_no.description: Batch number. Omit to use a new batch (see the WizCloud docs).

insert_into_last_batch.description: Insert into the last open batch (default false).

Description.description: Free text, max 250 characters; see the WizCloud field limits.

items.description: One journal transaction. Field names follow the WizCloud Import Journal transactions page.

prompts.title: Get started with WizCloud
prompts.description: What you can do with WizCloud here, with example requests to try.
